stem.x: Which of the following is an appropriate explanation of an actuator?

b.x: It amplifies weak electrical signals sent from microphones, sensors, and similar devices.
It compares a given target value with a controlled value obtained from a sensor, and outputs an operation amount to match the controlled value with the target value.
It converts power from an energy source into rotation, translational motion, or other movements based on control signals.
It detects position, angle, velocity, acceleration, force, temperature, and similar parameters, and converts them into electrical information.
